questions.question: Who counseled Ahaziah to do wickedly?
What did Athaliah do when she saw her son was dead?
options: Repented and turned back to God
Destroyed all the royal family of Judah
Fled away from the city in fear for her life
questions.answer: Destroyed all the royal family of Judah

questions.question: Joash was hidden from Athaliah by Jehoshabeath and survived.
